study: Study 2: tagger accuracy on learner English

learner_eslspok.description: UD_English-ESLSpok (Kyle et al. 2022): spoken L2 English, Japanese learners, NICT JLE interviews; all splits

baseline_ewt.description: UD_English-EWT test split (Silveira et al. 2014): edited English web text

speed.method: Raw text strings (one per study text) through lexinspect's pipeline (get_nlp: tokeniser, tagger, parser, attribute ruler, lemmatiser; NER excluded), one text per call, CPU only, after 5 warm-up texts. Words are lexinspect words.

size.note: trf_added_dependencies lists every distribution outside the project venv in this run (installed by `uv run --with`): the trf model and the packages it pulls in (PyTorch, spacy-curated-transformers, ...).
